reaching the cap is charged the full cap. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

    for c in (20,21): G[r][c]=2

    for c in range(4,8): G[r][c]=2
for r in (20,21):
    for c in (19,20): G[r][c]=2
# complete TR reflected horizontally
for r in (3,4): G[r][20]=9
G[4][21]=5
for r in (5,6):
    G[r][18]=G[r][19]=1; G[r][22]=3
# BL scaled x2, vertically reflected

    G[r][2]=G[r][3]=3
    for c in range(8,12): G[r][c]=1
for r in (23,24):

for r in range(23,27):
